major.comment: The engine moves from `@astroapps/controls@^1.4` to `@react-typed-forms/core@^5.0.0`, which is now a peer dependency. v5 folds the `@astroapps/controls` engine in and is ESM-only, and a consuming app must mount `<ControlContextProvider value={getCompatContext()}>` above its tree — v5 has no implicit control context and no no-provider fallback. `SchemaInterface.makeEqualityFunc` and `makeControlSetup` are removed, along with `DefaultSchemaInterface.compoundFieldEquality`, `compoundFieldSetup` and the `EqualityFunc` type. They existed to build a per-field `ControlSetup.equals`, which the v5 engine no longer honours — it has context-level `deepEquals` only, and would have ignored a supplied comparator with nothing worse than a dev-mode warning. Removing them turns that silent loss into a compile error. A consumer overriding `makeEqualityFunc` for custom equality has no replacement in this API and must compare values itself

minor.comment: withScripts now accepts dotted paths (e.g. "displayData.text") and builds the per-object-level $scripts nesting they imply, and merges with any existing scripts instead of replacing them. Previously a dotted key was taken literally, matched no schema field and was silently dropped, so scripts intended for a nested object never ran

patch.comment: Upgrade to jsonata 2.1.0 so that the null coalescing operator exists
Clear child nodes when parent datanode changes

minor.comment: Add createScriptedProxy, ScriptProvider, and defaultScriptProvider for scripted definition proxy support.
